name: Do I have a personal injury case?

mainEntity.name: Do I have a personal injury case?

acceptedAnswer.text: You may have a personal injury case if you were harmed due to someone else’s negligence, carelessness, or intentional conduct. Determining whether a valid claim exists depends on factors such as fault, causation, damages, and applicable legal deadlines.
